This is well-documented in the repo itself, comments spell out every constraint.

**Big: 1082 occurrences across 94 files, but most is safe to rename.**

Off-limits, confirmed in-repo:

| Location | Why frozen |
|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | Public API contract, `account_id` is a documented field/query param, renaming breaks every client |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | `WIRE` map ships `account_id` to JSON on purpose, comment says internal renames must not reach this side |
| `migrations/*.sql` | Already applied in production, editing history doesn't rename a live column and breaks the down step |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk/](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/schema.js:3) | Vendored/generated, "Do not edit", overwritten on next `vendor:refresh`, and it's the wire format to an external reporting service |
| [lib/audit.js](lib/audit.js:3) | Audit log field, past log lines already carry `account_id` |

Everything else, the actual DB column name and internal service code across `services/*/repo`, `service`, `http`, is fair game, that's the bulk of the 1082 hits. A real rename needs a new migration to rename the DB column plus `serialize.js` and `openapi.yaml` left untouched (or bumped as a new API version if the public name ever changes).

Sign-off take: approve renaming the internal column and code, block renaming the public wire field, vendor SDK, and historical migrations/audit records.
